name: Kryo
tagline: Real-time thermal guard for India’s cold-chain supply
prompt: A control room for a cold-chain logistics company tracking refrigerated trucks and their temperatures across India

spec.name: Kryo
spec.world: Fleet contains 142 active reefer trucks (Tata Prima, BharatBenz) hauling temperature-sensitive cargoes like Gliclazide insulin (target 2°C to 8°C) from Hyderabad to Delhi, and Alphonso mangoes from Ratnagiri to Mumbai Port. Ambient outside temperatures reach 44.5°C near Nagpur, while inside cargo remains strictly at 4.2°C. Drivers like Harpreet Singh and Rajesh Gowda log continuous telemetry via IoT sensors.

imagery.subject: A close-up macro shot of a sealed stainless steel digital temperature recorder mounted inside a frosted, sub-zero truck cargo bay.
A heavy-duty BharatBenz refrigeration truck driving through a dusty, sun-drenched Indian highway corridor with heat distortion visible in the air.
A dark, high-contrast control room environment showing a multi-screen telemetry layout plotting micro-fluctuations in thermal lines.
Phials of insulin vaccine packed neatly inside insulated cold boxes surrounded by specialized gel cooling packs showing condensation.

spec.summary: An intelligent control room dashboard for refrigerated fleets transporting sensitive pharmaceuticals and fresh produce across extreme Indian climates.
spec.tagline: Real-time thermal guard for India’s cold-chain supply
spec.audience: Cold-chain operations managers, dispatchers, and quality assurance leads at major pharmaceutical and fresh retail brands.

directions.why: It aligns perfectly with the high-stakes, mission-critical nature of heavy transport monitoring where split-second thermal data saves millions of rupees in medical cargo.
directions.twist: A high-contrast black-box aesthetic with glowing neon-green and warning-amber telemetry curves, mimicking cockpit avionics with customized Indian highway transit symbols.

directions.why: Cold-chain logistics requires extreme organizational precision, legible typographic hierarchies, and reliable grids that work under stressful operations.
directions.twist: Using an ultra-rigid multi-column grid layout, set in a severe grotesque typeface, using purely high-density data tables and stark red-and-white color fills for temperature warnings.

directions.why: Provides a familiar, highly professional, and polished platform layout that corporate stakeholders at pharmaceutical clients instantly trust.
directions.twist: A clean, clinical cool-gray interface featuring subtle frosted-glass telemetry cards, specialized compliance progress rings, and elegant vector routes of India's golden quadrilateral.

spec.heroObject: The absolute thermal variance across live transit routes

directions.why: It aligns perfectly with the high-stakes, mission-critical nature of heavy transport monitoring where split-second thermal data saves millions of rupees in medical cargo.
directions.name: Kryo Tactical Avionics
directions.pitch: A high-density cockpit-style console built for uninterrupted thermal vigilance on extreme Indian corridors, utilizing absolute data and razor-sharp telemetry.
directions.twist: A high-contrast black-box aesthetic with glowing neon-green and warning-amber telemetry curves, mimicking cockpit avionics with customized Indian highway transit symbols.
directions.motion: Immediate and precise 120ms transitions without easing overhead. Real-time value updates are instant without numerical counters or tickers.
directions.imagery: No photographic imagery. Purely abstract data visualization, absolute vector temperature curves, and geo-coordinates mapped on high-contrast vector paths of the Golden Quadrilateral.
signature: Continuous 24-hour telemetry ticker at the absolute top of the screen
Real-time visual route deviation indicators using terminal-style angled arrows
Interactive micro-climate alerts mapped with dynamic sensor-level timestamps

directions.name: Kryo Rational Grid
directions.pitch: A stark, zero-compromise layout system driven by architectural geometry, massive asymmetric typography, and a commanding red-and-black structural layout.
directions.twist: Using an ultra-rigid multi-column grid layout, set in a severe grotesque typeface, using purely high-density data tables and stark red-and-white color fills for temperature warnings.
directions.motion: Mechanical, strict 150ms structural translations. No bounce, no elasticity; components appear or move directly along linear paths.
directions.imagery: Strictly high-contrast black-and-white industrial photography, hard-cropped at 90-degree angles directly inside structural grid divisions.
signature: Massive, page-spanning headline figures cropped directly by the viewport margins
Strict 1px solid black boundary line grids wrapping every single layout interface column
Asymmetric sidebar blocks where section labels hang to the extreme outer margins
